QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/...`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the order of environment overrides, then the default user directory, then the system library cache (`find_library`). It also mentions nested and flat layouts, though only against `ENTROPIC_HOME`, not against every root.
